summary: BEFORE serial 16x ~3ms CPU-bound units: 172.62ms; AFTER 2-thread pool: 229.08ms — slower (within noise, but never faster across repeats). CPython threads cannot parallelize CPU-bound work (GIL); thread-pool dispatch is pure overhead here. Claim false for CPU-bound Python; see BAC-0096 for the process-pool variant.
